_comment: Copy to live-work/chunk-scope.json when a chunk starts. Enforced by .claude/hooks/chunk-scope-guard.js before every Edit/Write. Absent file = no enforcement (opt-in by design). See ai-system/live-work-protocol.md section 8.
chunk: short name of the current chunk
_files: Paths the chunk may edit. Empty or omitted = no path restriction, protected list still applies. Supports exact paths, 'dir/' prefixes, and * wildcards.
_protected: Approved-foundation paths the Builder must not touch. Denied unless the same path also appears in 'unlocked'.
_unlocked: Protected paths Carl has explicitly authorised for THIS chunk. Overrides 'protected'. Carl's call, not the Builder's.
